tools.name: browse_projects
tools.description: Find, list, or inspect GitLab projects. Actions: search (find by name/topic across GitLab), list (browse accessible projects or group projects), get (retrieve full project details). Related: manage_project to create/update/delete projects.

action.description: Action to perform: search, list, get

q.description: Global search query. Searches project names, paths, descriptions. Required for 'search' action(s).

visibility.description: Filter by visibility: public, internal, or private. Required for 'search', 'list' action(s).

archived.description: Filter by archive status. true=archived only, false=active only. Required for 'search', 'list' action(s).

order_by.description: Sort field for results. Required for 'search', 'list' action(s).

sort.description: Sort direction: asc or desc. Required for 'search', 'list' action(s).

with_programming_language.description: Filter by programming language (e.g., "javascript", "python"). Required for 'search', 'list' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'search', 'list' action(s).

group_id.description: Group ID to list projects within. If omitted, lists YOUR accessible projects. Required for 'list' action(s).

search.description: Text filter for list action (filters results by name/description). Required for 'list' action(s).

owned.description: Show only projects you own (not just member of). Required for 'list' action(s).

starred.description: Show only starred/favorited projects. Required for 'list' action(s).

membership.description: Show only projects where you have membership. Required for 'list' action(s).

simple.description: Return minimal fields for faster response. Default: true. Required for 'list' action(s).

include_subgroups.description: Include projects from subgroups (requires group_id). Required for 'list' action(s).

with_shared.description: Include shared projects (requires group_id). Required for 'list' action(s).

project_id.description: Project identifier. Numeric ID or URL-encoded path (e.g., "42" or "gitlab-org%2Fgitlab"). Required for 'get' action(s).

statistics.description: Include repository statistics. Required for 'get' action(s).

license.description: Include license information. Required for 'get' action(s).

tools.name: browse_namespaces
tools.description: Explore GitLab groups and user namespaces. Actions: list (discover available namespaces), get (retrieve details with storage stats), verify (check if path exists). Related: manage_namespace to create/update/delete groups.

action.description: Action to perform: list, get, verify

search.description: Search namespaces by name/path. Required for 'list' action(s).

owned_only.description: Show only namespaces you own. Required for 'list' action(s).

top_level_only.description: Show only root-level namespaces. Required for 'list' action(s).

with_statistics.description: Include storage/count statistics. Required for 'list' action(s).

min_access_level.description: Minimum access level: 10=Guest, 20=Reporter, 30=Developer, 40=Maintainer, 50=Owner. Required for 'list' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'list' action(s).

namespace_id.description: Namespace ID or path. Required for 'get', 'verify' action(s).

tools.name: browse_commits
tools.description: Explore repository commit history and diffs. Actions: list (browse commits with filters), get (retrieve commit metadata and stats), diff (view code changes). Related: browse_refs for branch/tag info.

action.description: Action to perform: list, get, diff

ref_name.description: Branch/tag name. Defaults to default branch. Required for 'list' action(s).

since.description: Start date filter (ISO 8601 format). Required for 'list' action(s).

until.description: End date filter (ISO 8601 format). Required for 'list' action(s).

path.description: Filter commits affecting this file/directory path. Required for 'list' action(s).

author.description: Filter by author name or email. Required for 'list' action(s).

all.description: Include commits from all branches. Required for 'list' action(s).

first_parent.description: Follow only first parent (linear history). Required for 'list' action(s).

order.description: Commit ordering: default or topo. Required for 'list' action(s).

with_stats.description: Include stats for each commit. Required for 'list' action(s).

trailers.description: Include Git trailers (Signed-off-by, etc.). Required for 'list' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'list', 'diff' action(s).

sha.description: Commit SHA. Can be full SHA, short hash, or ref name. Required for 'get', 'diff' action(s).

stats.description: Include file change statistics. Required for 'get' action(s).

unidiff.description: Return unified diff format. Required for 'diff' action(s).

tools.name: browse_events
tools.description: Track GitLab activity and events. Actions: user (your activity across all projects), project (specific project activity feed). Filter by date range, action type, or target type.

action.description: Action to perform: user, project

sort.description: Sort order: asc=oldest first, desc=newest first.

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100)

tools.name: browse_users
tools.description: Find GitLab users with smart pattern detection. Actions: search (find users by name/email/username with transliteration support), get (retrieve specific user by ID). Related: browse_members for project/group membership.

action.description: Action to perform: search, get

username.description: Exact username to search for. Case-sensitive. Required for 'search' action(s).

public_email.description: Find user by exact public email address. Required for 'search' action(s).

search.description: Partial text search across name, username, and email. Required for 'search' action(s).

smart_search.description: Enable smart search with auto-detection and transliteration. Auto-enabled for search parameter. Required for 'search' action(s).

active.description: Filter for active (true) or inactive (false) users. Required for 'search' action(s).

external.description: Filter for external users with limited access. Required for 'search' action(s).

blocked.description: Filter for blocked users. Required for 'search' action(s).

humans.description: Filter for human users only (exclude bots). Required for 'search' action(s).

created_after.description: Filter users created after this date (ISO 8601). Required for 'search' action(s).

created_before.description: Filter users created before this date (ISO 8601). Required for 'search' action(s).

exclude_active.description: Exclude active users. Required for 'search' action(s).

exclude_external.description: Exclude external users. Required for 'search' action(s).

exclude_humans.description: Exclude human users. Required for 'search' action(s).

exclude_internal.description: Exclude internal system users. Required for 'search' action(s).

without_project_bots.description: Exclude project bot users. Required for 'search' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'search' action(s).

user_id.description: User ID to retrieve. Required for 'get' action(s).

tools.name: browse_todos
tools.description: View your GitLab todo queue (notifications requiring action). Actions: list (filter by state, action type, target type). Todos are auto-created for assignments, mentions, reviews, and pipeline failures. Related: manage_todos to mark done/restore.

action.description: Action to perform: list

state.description: Filter todos by state: pending=active, done=completed.

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100)

tools.name: manage_project
tools.description: Create, update, or manage GitLab projects. Actions: create (new project with settings), fork (copy existing project), update (modify settings), delete (remove permanently), archive/unarchive (toggle read-only), transfer (move to different namespace). Related: browse_projects for discovery.

action.description: Action to perform: create, fork, update, delete, archive, unarchive, transfer

name.description: New project name. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

namespace.description: Target namespace path. Omit for current user namespace. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'transfer' action(s).

description.description: New project description. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

visibility.description: Project visibility level. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

initialize_with_readme.description: Create initial README.md file. Required for 'create' action(s).

issues_enabled.description: Enable issue tracking. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

merge_requests_enabled.description: Enable merge requests. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

jobs_enabled.description: Enable CI/CD jobs. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

wiki_enabled.description: Enable project wiki. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

snippets_enabled.description: Enable code snippets. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

lfs_enabled.description: Enable Git LFS. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

request_access_enabled.description: Allow access requests. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds.description: Require passing pipelines for merge. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

only_allow_merge_if_all_discussions_are_.description: Require resolved discussions for merge. Required for 'create', 'fork', 'update' action(s).

project_id.description: Source project to fork. Numeric ID or URL-encoded path. Required for 'fork', 'update', 'delete', 'archive', 'unarchive', 'transfer' action(s).

namespace_path.description: Target namespace path for fork. Required for 'fork' action(s).

fork_name.description: New name for forked project (maps to API 'name' parameter). Required for 'fork' action(s).

fork_path.description: New path for forked project (maps to API 'path' parameter). Required for 'fork' action(s).

default_branch.description: Set default branch name. Required for 'update' action(s).

tools.name: manage_namespace
tools.description: Create, update, or delete GitLab groups/namespaces. Actions: create (new group with visibility/settings), update (modify group settings), delete (remove permanently). Related: browse_namespaces for discovery.

action.description: Action to perform: create, update, delete

name.description: Group display name. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

path.description: Group path for URLs (URL-safe). Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

description.description: New group description. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

visibility.description: Group visibility level. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

parent_id.description: Parent group ID for subgroup. Required for 'create' action(s).

lfs_enabled.description: Enable Git LFS. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

request_access_enabled.description: Allow access requests. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

default_branch_protection.description: Branch protection level: 0=none, 1=partial, 2=full. Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

avatar.description: Group avatar URL. Required for 'create' action(s).

group_id.description: Group ID or URL-encoded path. Required for 'update', 'delete' action(s).

tools.name: manage_todos
tools.description: Manage your GitLab todo queue. Actions: mark_done (complete a single todo), mark_all_done (clear entire queue), restore (undo completion). Related: browse_todos to view your todo list.

action.description: Action to perform: mark_done, mark_all_done, restore

id.description: Todo ID to mark as done Required for 'mark_done', 'restore' action(s).

tools.name: manage_context
tools.description: View and manage runtime session configuration. Actions: show (current host/preset/scope/mode), list_presets (available tool configurations), list_profiles (OAuth users), whoami (token introspection with live refresh - detects permission changes and updates available tools), switch_preset (change active preset), switch_profile (change OAuth user), set_scope (restrict to namespace), reset (restore initial state). Use whoami to diagnose access issues and verify token permissions.

action.description: Action to perform: show, list_presets, list_profiles, switch_preset, switch_profile, set_scope, reset, whoami

preset.description: Name of the preset to activate Required for 'switch_preset' action(s).

profile.description: Name of the profile to activate Required for 'switch_profile' action(s).

namespace.description: Namespace path (e.g., 'my-group' or 'group/project') - type is auto-detected Required for 'set_scope' action(s).

includeSubgroups.description: Include subgroups when scope is a group (default: true) Required for 'set_scope' action(s).

tools.name: browse_labels
tools.description: List and inspect project or group labels. Actions: list (all labels with search filtering), get (single label by ID or name). Related: manage_label to create/update/delete.

action.description: Action to perform: list, get

search.description: Keyword to filter labels by Required for 'list' action(s).

with_counts.description: Include issue and merge request counts Required for 'list' action(s).

include_ancestor_groups.description: Include ancestor groups when listing or getting labels

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'list' action(s).

label_id.description: The ID or title of the label Required for 'get' action(s).

tools.name: manage_label
tools.description: Create, update, or delete project/group labels. Actions: create (name + hex color required), update (modify properties), delete (remove permanently). Related: browse_labels for discovery.

action.description: Action to perform: create, update, delete

name.description: The name of the label Required for 'create', 'update' action(s).

label_id.description: The ID or title of the label Required for 'update', 'delete' action(s).

new_name.description: The new name of the label Required for 'update' action(s).

tools.name: browse_merge_requests

milestone.description: Filter by milestone title. Use "None" or "Any". Required for 'list' action(s).

view.description: Response detail level Required for 'list' action(s).

labels.description: Filter by labels Required for 'list' action(s).

with_labels_details.description: Return full label objects Required for 'list' action(s).

with_merge_status_recheck.description: Trigger async recheck of merge status Required for 'list' action(s).

created_after.description: Filter MRs created after (ISO 8601) Required for 'list' action(s).

created_before.description: Filter MRs created before (ISO 8601) Required for 'list' action(s).

updated_after.description: Filter MRs modified after (ISO 8601) Required for 'list' action(s).

updated_before.description: Filter MRs modified before (ISO 8601) Required for 'list' action(s).

author_id.description: Filter by author's user ID Required for 'list' action(s).

author_username.description: Filter by author's username Required for 'list' action(s).

assignee_id.description: Filter by assignee's user ID Required for 'list' action(s).

assignee_username.description: Filter by assignee's username Required for 'list' action(s).

my_reaction_emoji.description: Filter MRs you've reacted to Required for 'list' action(s).

source_branch.description: Filter by source branch Required for 'list' action(s).

target_branch.description: Filter by target branch Required for 'list' action(s).

search.description: Text search in title/description Required for 'list' action(s).

environment.description: Filter by deployment environment Required for 'list' action(s).

deployed_before.description: Filter MRs deployed before Required for 'list' action(s).

deployed_after.description: Filter MRs deployed after Required for 'list' action(s).

approved_by_ids.description: Filter MRs approved by user IDs Required for 'list' action(s).

approved_by_usernames.description: Filter MRs approved by usernames Required for 'list' action(s).

reviewer_id.description: Filter by reviewer user ID Required for 'list' action(s).

reviewer_username.description: Filter by reviewer username Required for 'list' action(s).

with_api_entity_associations.description: Include extra API associations Required for 'list' action(s).

min_access_level.description: Minimum access level filter (10-50) Required for 'list' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'list', 'diffs', 'versions' action(s).

merge_request_iid.description: Internal MR ID. Required unless branch_name provided. Required for 'get', 'diffs', 'versions', 'version' action(s).

branch_name.description: Find MR by its source branch name Required for 'get' action(s).

action.description: Action to perform: list, drafts, draft

merge_request_iid.description: Internal MR ID unique to project

tools.name: manage_member
tools.description: Add, remove, or update access levels for project/group members. Actions: add_to_project, add_to_group (with access level + optional expiry), remove_from_project, remove_from_group, update_project, update_group (change access level). Related: browse_members for current membership.

action.description: Action to perform: add_to_project, add_to_group, remove_from_project, remove_from_group, update_project, update_group

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path Required for 'add_to_project', 'remove_from_project', 'update_project' action(s).

access_level.description: Access level: 0=No access, 5=Minimal, 10=Guest, 20=Reporter, 30=Developer, 40=Maintainer, 50=Owner Required for 'add_to_project', 'add_to_group', 'update_project', 'update_group' action(s).

expires_at.description: Membership expiration date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) Required for 'add_to_project', 'add_to_group', 'update_project', 'update_group' action(s).

group_id.description: Group ID or URL-encoded path Required for 'add_to_group', 'remove_from_group', 'update_group' action(s).

skip_subresources.description: Skip removing from subgroups and projects Required for 'remove_from_project', 'remove_from_group' action(s).

unassign_issuables.description: Unassign member from issues and merge requests Required for 'remove_from_project', 'remove_from_group' action(s).

member_role_id.description: ID of a custom member role (Ultimate only) Required for 'update_group' action(s).

tools.name: browse_search
tools.description: Search across GitLab resources globally or within a scope. Actions: global (entire instance), project (within specific project), group (within specific group). Searchable: projects, issues, merge_requests, milestones, users, blobs (code), commits, wiki_blobs, notes.

action.description: Action to perform: global, project, group

scope.description: Search scope determining what type of resources to search

state.description: Filter by state (for issues and merge_requests scopes)

confidential.description: Filter by confidentiality (for issues scope, Premium only)

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100)

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path (e.g., 'group/project' or '123') Required for 'project' action(s).

ref.description: Branch/tag reference for code search (blobs, commits) Required for 'project' action(s).

group_id.description: Group ID or URL-encoded path (e.g., 'my-group' or '123') Required for 'group' action(s).

tools.name: browse_iterations
tools.description: View group iterations for agile sprint planning. Actions: list (filter by state: current, upcoming, closed), get (retrieve specific iteration details). Related: browse_work_items for items in an iteration.

action.description: Action to perform: list, get

state.description: Filter by iteration state. Required for 'list' action(s).

search.description: Search iterations by title. Required for 'list' action(s).

include_ancestors.description: Include iterations from parent groups. Required for 'list' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'list' action(s).
